g: (pathology) The presence of an abnormally small number of platelets in a fetus' blood, due to the mother's antibodies having been passed via the placenta and attacking the platelets.
(pathology) A deficiency in the number of platelets in a fetus' blood, due to the mother's antibodies having been passed via the placenta and attacking the fetus' own platelets.
(chemistry) (metrology) Symbol for femtomole, an SI unit of amount of substance equal to 10⁻¹⁵ moles.
